summary: Ground explicit drawing identifiers as atomic cited values and keep them scoped to exact workflow identities, source findings and Sheet locators.
decision_refs: The active goal requires continued RFI, Submittal and Email accuracy and adaptability
Project Q&A already retrieves evidence by exact Sheet locator
An offline reproduction proved that the validator accepted a drawing identifier recombined from two cited sheets
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes deterministic answer-accuracy improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
known_limitations: Only explicitly labelled Sheet, Drawing and Dwg forms with a bounded digit-bearing identifier are interpreted.
Unlabelled codes, arbitrary prose and date-shaped values do not support a drawing-identifier claim.
The guard does not determine applicability, discipline, revision, contractual authority, precedence or whether every relevant file was parsed.
